text:
Alex M.: Quick sketch — proposing a small contract for prefetch fallbacks + a 'tenant folding' mode to reduce cold-hit storms when capacity is tight. Want a quick sanity check before I jam this into the RFC followup.
Priya (she/her): Can you summarize the safety invariants? worried about stale KV leaks across tenants if we fold groups.
Alex M.: Yeah — two invariants I care about: 1) no cross-tenant data exposure (keys must always be namespaced/opaque), 2) bounded staleness for folded-prefetch entries (we accept up to X ms of staleness under fallback but no indefinite sharing). Folding only groups tenants by prefix-pattern similarity, never merges their write paths.
Sam O'Neill: Otherwise curious how eviction interacts. If a folded group gets evicted, do we evict everyone in the group or evict by per-tenant LRU weight? Tradeoffs?
Alex M.: Good Q. Plan A: keep per-tenant residency accounting while allowing a shared prefetch pool. Eviction decisions still consult per-tenant credits; folding only enables shared prefetch *reads* and shared batching, not unified residency ownership.
Jamie (ENG): So residency accounting still prevents tenant B from freeloading on tenant A's reserved allocation. Works. How do we decide fold clusters in production?
Alex M.: Two mechanisms: heuristics based on prefix similarity + past prefix coaccess patterns, and an explicit policy flag customers can opt into for predictable billing. We'll surface a metric: fold_hit_ratio per cluster.
Marta S.: I want to call out correctness edge: what happens under lease reassignments? If we fold and A's lease moves off node, do we risk serving stale cached prefixes for A from the folded pool on old node?
Alex M.: Lease reassignments are the thorn. My proposal: when a lease transfers, we tag folded-prefetch entries with a short TTL and mark them 'soft-stale'. Any access to a 'soft-stale' key will trigger a validation handshake: quick lease-owner check (cheap RPC) — if mismatch, invalidate and fetch fresh. This keeps fast-path for steady-state, correctness for churn.
Priya (she/her): That extra owner-check RPC on soft-stale hits — what's the expected p50/p95 added latency? we need numbers for SLO review.
Alex M.: Ballpark: p50 ~ +0.5ms, p95 ~ +2.5ms (depends on region). We'll gate by a config flag and add dynamic sampling so only a small fraction pay the owner-check cost while we ramp.
Sam O'Neill: Can we do optimistic validation from the sequencer? e.g., include lease_version in the cached item and check locally if seq.version == cached.version, avoid RPC most times.
Alex M.: Exactly — include lease_version in metadata. Validation only hits RPC when versions differ. Also plan to piggyback version in normal control-plane heartbeats to reduce diff windows.
Jamie (ENG): Any failure modes where folded prefetch causes a wrong-model serving (i.e., wrong prefix returned under A's model variant)? We need to ensure model variant pinning isn't violated.
Alex M.: Model variants are part of the cache key. Folding groups only combine tenants with compatible model_variant constraints. If a tenant pins a variant that isn't compatible, they opt-out of folding automatically.
Marta S.: Operationally, how do we roll this out? I want gradual: 1) observe, 2) canary read-only folding, 3) canary read-write (if ever), 4) global. What metrics should we watch?
Alex M.: Rollout steps match yours. Key metrics: fold_hit_ratio, fold_eviction_rate, validation_rpc_rate, soft_stale_miss_rate, per-tenant tail latency change, and any dropped lease-invalidations. Add a safety alert if validation_rpc_rate exceeds threshold or if per-tenant p99 increases > 10%.
deploybot: build/ci #prefetch-folding spike-tests succeeded — 28 tests passed, 3 flaky flagged. https://ci.redwood/build/12345
Priya (she/her): Ok +1 to the incremental plan. Please add explicit config knobs and an emergency kill switch in the console.
Sam O'Neill: I'll prototype the residency accounting shim to keep per-tenant quotas enforced; will post a draft PR tomorrow.
Jamie (ENG): I'll add an eval harness to ensure model-variant compatibility checks run in the path and produce audible logs.
Alex M.: Thanks all — I'll drop a compact RFC follow-up with the config snippet and perf simulations. snippet below for the fallback contract (rough):

```json
{"fold_enabled": true,
 "fold_mode": "read_shared",
 "soft_stale_ttl_ms": 5000,
 "validation_sampling_pct": 5,
 "per_tenant_quota_mode": "accounted"
}
```

Alex M.: Ping @Marta S. for SRE runbook section and @Priya for privacy checklist. If no objections by EOD, I'll land the follow-up doc.
Marta S.: I'll draft runbook items: emergency disable, metrics dashboard, and incident playbook for lease flaps.
Priya (she/her): I'll run a quick threat model pass tomorrow morning.
Sam O'Neill: PR link when ready and I'll review.
Jamie (ENG): :thumbsup:
Alex M.: :rocket:
